configure.editsDiscarded: Changing triggers regenerates the workflow, so your manual edits were discarded.
configure.jenkinsTriggerLimits: Jenkins has no PR events: build 1 of a PR-<n> job counts as opened, every later build (including a manual rebuild or replay) as synchronize. Reopen is not supported.

failCiOn.title: Fail CI on

connection.title: Jenkins connection
connection.description: Jenkins server for {repo}. The API token is stored on this machine and never shown again.
connection.tokenHint: Create one in Jenkins: your user, Security, API Token.
connection.removeConfirm: Remove the Jenkins connection for {repo}? Installations and CI runs are kept, but they stop syncing until you connect again.

testCodes.jenkins_auth_failed: Jenkins rejected the username or API token.
testCodes.jenkins_unreachable: Jenkins could not be reached at this URL.
testCodes.jenkins_not_jenkins: The server at this URL is not Jenkins.
testCodes.jenkins_not_configured: Enter the URL, username and API token first.

jenkins_not_configured.what: No Jenkins connection for this repository.
jenkins_not_configured.fix: Connect the repository to its Jenkins server.

jenkins_connection_mismatch.what: The saved Jenkins URL is a different server than the one this agent was exported to.
jenkins_connection_mismatch.fix: Point the connection back to that server, or re-export the agent.

jenkins_auth_failed.what: Jenkins rejected the saved username or API token.
jenkins_auth_failed.fix: Update the API token in the connection.

jenkins_unreachable.fix: Check that Jenkins is running and the URL is right, then refresh.

jenkins_job_not_found.what: The Jenkins job for this agent was not found.
jenkins_job_not_found.fix: Create the Multibranch job, or re-export with the right job name.
